items.docs: This GET endpoint retrieves the current status of a merge task for a specific pull request in a Bitbucket repository. By providing the workspace identifier, repository slug, pull request ID, and task ID in the URL path, users can poll this endpoint to monitor the progress of an asynchronous merge operation. items.docs: This API endpoint retrieves the restriction status for a specific group on a piece of Confluence content. It requires three path parameters: the content ID, an operation key (typically 'read' or 'update'), and a group ID.
